gloss: root cause, chief culprit, main offender

definitions.gloss: root cause, chief culprit, main offender
definitions.explanation: The primary source of a problem or the person most responsible for causing harm. Carries a strongly negative connotation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{元凶|げんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: Look for the root cause of the problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{元凶|げんきょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧だった。
examples.english: The main cause of the traffic jam was road construction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{元凶|げんきょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ようやく⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The person who was the chief culprit behind years of fraud was finally arrested.

notes:
{元凶|げんきょう} can refer to both a person (the culprit) and a thing (the root cause). Always carries negative connotation — it assigns blame.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {元凶|げんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}き{止|と}める→突き止める：09344_tsukitomeru⟧: to identify the root cause
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{元凶|げんきょう}: root cause of the problem
- {諸悪|しょあく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{元凶|げんきょう}: the source of all evils
- {元凶|げんきょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become the chief cause

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧: cause (neutral, objective)
- ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧: culprit, criminal (person only)
- ⟦{根源|こんげん}→根源：19932_kongen⟧: root, origin (neutral to negative)
- ⟦{張本人|ちょうほんにん}→張本人：26787_chouhonnin⟧: the person responsible (strongly negative)

PRONUNCIATION:
Also read as げんきゅう, though げんきょう is more common today.
